`Vanilla1121_functions.cpp` contains only the two original reference functions
used by the sight-batch parity test. Source:
[ERitzman/UnitXP_SP3, commit 36fca988241840f53720376d787b1f8685956568](https://github.com/ERitzman/UnitXP_SP3/blob/36fca988241840f53720376d787b1f8685956568/Vanilla1121_functions.cpp).
